newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN RUPIAH FALLS TO HISTORIC LOW BUT STABLE.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN RUPIAH FALLS TO HISTORIC LOW BUT STABLE.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah stabilised against the dollar at a historic low in morning trade on Thursday after the central bank scrapped the announcement of the intervention and conversion bands, dealers said.
Spot rupiah stabilised at 2,750/80 at 0350 GMT after strengthening to 2,635 in early morning from an opening of 2,648/58 on Thursday.
Dealers however said the market remained jittery after the announcement, which economists said implied a managed float.
Longer-term swap rates fell after the announcement.
Bank Indonesia said it will no longer announce its daily intervention and conversion bands with immediate effect.

"The government has decided effective from today, August 14, the announcement of intervention and conversion bands, which are usually announced at 3 p.m. local time (0800 GMT), will be abolished," the central bank said in a statement.
One state bank dealer said the statement did not imply the abolishment of the band but only its announcement.
"This implies that the band will be invisible, allowing the central bank to intervene any time it wants," the dealer said.
The state bank dealer said the move would help the country safeguard its valuable reserves.
"It's a sort of managed float," said Desmond Supple, regional currencies specialist at BZW Asia in Singapore.
"Basically Bank Indonesia can intervene at any time. It's a good move. It's much more prudent than widening the band and giving the market a fresh target to aim at."
"Doggedly defending the band would whittle away at the country's reserves, raise interest rates and slow growth."
He said it was not surprising that the rupiah had plunged on the announcement but said there was scope for recovery later.

"We are going to see substantial over-shooting," Supple said. "But it (the announcement) lays the conditions for reversal of the rupiah in the long-term and bring it back to a semblance of fair value."
The last intervention band announced by the central bank on Wednesday was 2,378/2,682 and the conversion band at 2,629/2,677.
